title: Dereth Town Tour - Sanamar scratch

shots.standingOrder: Rise from 4 m over the beach south-east of Sanamar up the coastal slope until the walled city and its gold-roofed towers appear over the edge.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING (drone.rising-reveal). Starts 4 m over the sand of the south-east shore below the city, facing up the coastal slope (the 'southern coastal cliff' where Varicci II saw the red bull omen); rises 86 m in 14 s while easing 20 m forward until the curtain walls, the gold-roofed corner towers and spire towers of Sanamar appear over the crest; ends 180 m out at z 90 pitched -8. Morning sun from the east side-lights the south-east walls. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (9943.8,41586.4,4.0) end (9930.4,41601.2,90.0), min AGL 4.0 m, nearest static/building/tree 6.9 m (0x02001292@9949,41582), peak 9.9 m/s; WBT get-height at 5 path samples matched the checker terrain to 0.00 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hold at brazier height south-west of the King's statue, focused on the brazier flame in the foreground, then pull focus to King Varicci II.
shots.notes: FLAME + LANDMARK (classic.rack-focus). Camera at brazier height (z 57.5) 9.4 m SSW of the five-times-scale statue of King Varicci II (DefaultScale 5, ~9 m), the south-west column brazier (0x02000624: two flame puffs + warm halo, on a 4.3 m marble column) 3.4 m away in the left foreground and in focus; at 45 % the focus pulls over 1.6 s to the king on the right third, the flame melting into bokeh. Real DoF with ?clouds=on. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (9846.2,41716.1,57.5) end (9846.5,41716.6,57.7), min AGL 5.5 m, nearest static/building/tree 2.5 m (0x33D9#112 0x01003628), peak 0.1 m/s; WBT get-height at 5 path samples matched the checker terrain to 0.00 m.

shots.standingOrder: Start low south of the four-spout fountain between the blue-flame lamps and crane up and around to reveal the plaza, the gold-roofed halls and the city walls.
shots.notes: WATER + FLAME (classic.crane). Starts 2.7 m above the paving 14 m SSE of the four-spout fountain (0x0200123A, bubbly water arcs) ringed by four golden blue-flame lamps; cranes up 12 m and swings 30 deg while tilting down to -41 deg so the plaza, flowerbeds, the two gold-roofed Viamontian halls (18 m) and the west curtain wall with its corner towers open up around the water.
